name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Rail Pistol RP-2 'Verdict'
description: A compact electromagnetic rail pistol that accelerates a 3mm tungsten slug to hypersonic velocity using a miniaturized two-stage rail system. The RP-2 represents Zheng-Dao's attempt to compress railgun technology into a sidearm format, and the compromises are significant — the weapon generates extreme heat per shot, has a four-round capacity, and the rail erosion means the barrel assembly must be replaced every 80 rounds. Despite these limitations, the sheer penetrating power of a hypersonic tungsten slug fired from a pistol-sized platform has made it sought after by operators who need to defeat heavy armor at close range.
specifications:
caliber: 3mm tungsten slug
muzzle velocity: 2,200 m/s
magazine: 4 rounds
barrel life: 80 rounds before rail replacement
weight: 1.8 kg
recharge time: 3 seconds between shots
power source: Integrated supercapacitor, 20 shots per charge
penetration: Rated for Grade 4 composite armor at 10 meters
story_hooks: A dead mercenary was found with an RP-2 that has been fired exactly 80 times — the barrel is spent but the weapon was never serviced, suggesting it was issued for a single extended operation.
Zheng-Dao is offering a bounty for the return of prototype RP-3 units that were stolen during transit — the prototypes supposedly solve the barrel erosion problem.
related_entities: Ringo Heavy Transit MagRail Levitation Transport Network

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist, angular pistol with a pronounced forward-heavy stance. The weapon resembles a compact electromagnetic device more than a traditional firearm — all purposeful geometry and industrial aggression. The dual-stage rail system creates visible parallel channels along the top of the barrel assembly, giving it a distinctly mechanical, engineered appearance. Heat sinks protrude asymmetrically from the frame, and the overall silhouette is compact but dense with purpose.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 18 cm | Width: 4.5 cm | Height: 7 cm (including rail channels) | Barrel section: 11 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Dense and front-heavy. At 1.8 kg, it feels substantial in hand — every gram is engineered metal and capacitive technology. The weight distribution pulls forward, requiring a firm grip to manage recoil impulse from hypersonic acceleration.
physical_description.primary_material: Tungsten-reinforced steel frame with carbon-composite rail housing. Supercapacitor banks encased in brushed titanium alloy.
physical_description.finish: Utilitarian matte gunmetal gray on steel surfaces. Carbon-composite rail housing features a subtle crosshatch texture (friction-optimized). Titanium accents show brushed finish with minor oxidation patina, suggesting operational wear. Minimal polish — function over aesthetics.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with brushed titanium silver accents. Rail channels show faint copper oxidation from arc scoring. Supercapacitor vents feature industrial orange warning stripes (ZHENG-DAO standard).
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer wraparound with embedded cooling channels visible as fine ribbing. Designed for secure purchase with or without combat gloves. Slightly warm to the touch even when idle — passive heat dissipation from the integrated supercapacitor.
distinctive_features: Dual parallel electromagnetic rail channels running the length of the barrel — precision-machined with visible feed slots
Asymmetrical heat sink fins extending from the left rail housing, angled to shed thermal load
Recessed capacitor vent ports (3×) along the grip spine with faint orange warning etching
Charging port on the right side of the frame, recessed beneath a rubberized flip cover
Ammunition counter digital display (3mm red LED) mounted above the trigger guard — cycles 4, 3, 2, 1, EMPTY
Heavy scoring and micro-pitting on the barrel assembly from rail erosion — visible arc damage from previous 60+ round cycles
Integrated pressure relief valve (tiny threaded port) visible at the rear of the frame near the magwell
ZHENG-DAO corporate seal laser-etched into the left rail shroud
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo (stylized geometric character) stamped in brushed titanium on the left side of the frame, just forward of the grip. Model designation RP-2 and serial number laser-etched on the underside of the barrel housing. Mandatory military restriction warning symbol (Φ enclosed in a red octagon) on the right grip panel.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but maintained. Evidence of moderate use: the barrel shows the expected rail erosion scarring from operational cycling. Heat sink fins bear light carbon scoring from sustained fire. Grip texture remains intact with minimal polish wear on high-contact areas. Charging port cover shows minor stress cracking. Overall impression: a weapon in active service with a professional operator who understands the maintenance demands.
